def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    market_index_values = [3, 2, 4, 5, 6]
    nav_changes = [5, 4, 6, 7, 9]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    mean_index = sum(market_index_values) / len(market_index_values)
    mean_nav = sum(nav_changes) / len(nav_changes)

    numerator = sum(
        (x - mean_index) * (y - mean_nav)
        for x, y in zip(market_index_values, nav_changes)
    )
    denominator = sum((x - mean_index) ** 2 for x in market_index_values)
    slope = numerator / denominator

    # return answer
    return round(slope, 2)
